lines.beaver: 민수야, 다음 주 시험 준비는 어떻게 해?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, how are you preparing for next week's test?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsuya, daeum ju siheom junbineun eotteoke hae?
lines.learner: 시험 보기 전에 단어를 다 외울 거야.
lines.en: I'll memorize all the words before the test.
lines.roman: Siheom bogi jeone daneoreul da oeul kkeoya.

lines.beaver_en: There are so many words. How do you memorize them?
lines.en: I memorize twenty a day and write them down by dictation.
My academy teacher checks it for me.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, you go to an academy too?
lines.learner: 응, 일주일에 세 번 학원에 다녀.
lines.en: Yeah, I go to the academy three times a week.
lines.roman: Eung, iljuire se beon hagwone danyeo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do before going to the academy?
lines.en: I always preview the lesson before I go.

lines.beaver_en: Then what about after the academy?
lines.learner: 집에 와서 그날 배운 걸 복습해.
lines.en: I come home and review what I learned that day.
lines.roman: Jibe waseo geunal baeun geol bokseupae.

lines.en: My grades weren't good last time.

lines.beaver_en: Your grades will definitely go up this time.
lines.en: Thanks. I look at words before bed, too.
Sure! Let's study together at the library tomorrow.

lines.beaver_en: Okay, let's check each other's dictation.
lines.en: Great. See you tomorrow at two!
